definitions.gloss: artistic style; performance style; style of act
definitions.explanation: The characteristic style or manner of a performer, comedian, actor, or artist. Refers to their distinctive approach and the impression their performances give.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{芸風|げいふう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: That comedian changed his performance style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{芸風|げいふう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}いでいる→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧。
examples.english: He has inherited his master's artistic style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{芸風|げいふう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: With a unique performance style, they have gained popularity across a wide range of generations.

notes:
USAGE:
{芸風|げいふう} is most commonly used when discussing comedians, traditional performers (such as rakugo or kabuki actors), and entertainers. It describes the overall flavor, approach, and personality of their performances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芸風|げいふう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ (to change one's performance style)
- {芸風|げいふう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確立|かくりつ}→確立：13758_kakuritsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to establish one's artistic style)
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{芸風|げいふう} (a unique artistic style)
- {芸風|げいふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (to have a versatile performance range)
